client: Singapore Indian Chamber of Commerce & Industry (SICCI)
seo_title: SICCI Case Study: People-Led Chamber Content | SOMIN
description: Fyreflyz used SOMIN to read 1,820 peer chamber posts for SICCI and found its notices averaged 6 likes while its one post about a person drew 176.
eyebrow: Agency case study · Business chamber · Singapore
h1: SICCI's notices average 6 likes, its one post about a person drew 176
h1_em: its one post about a person drew 176
lede: Fyreflyz used SOMIN to compare 25 posts from the Singapore Indian Chamber of Commerce & Industry (SICCI) with 1,820 from six peer chambers. SICCI held 1.4% of chamber posts; the pitch builds three people-led series.
meta_line: A SOMIN agency pitch · 25 Feb to 25 Aug 2026 · Singapore

stats.label: SICCI's share of chamber posts, 90 days
On a people post, against 6 for a notice

challenge.title: SICCI's 1.4% share: six peers publish 73 posts to its one
challenge.body: SICCI's 25 posts in 90 days, 13 unique, were mostly notices and event recaps. Volume was not the only problem.

approach.title: SICCI's 25 posts against 1,820 from six peer chambers
points: Read monthly trends, Feb to Aug 2026, against August 2025.
Measured likes per post by post type.
Mapped the themes peers crowd, own or leave open.
Built three insight stories, nine propositions and 50 moment triggers.

findings_title: People posts, crowded India and an untold heritage story

findings.title: People beat notices in the same feed
findings.body: Event recaps averaged 52 likes; the peer average is 16.8 engagements per post.

findings.title: India is crowded, the entry story is not
findings.body: India is 25.1% of peer posts and 44% of SICCI's; CII posts 40 times more, but about India, not a Singapore firm's entry.

findings.title: Heritage is about 4% of peer posts, with no teller
findings.body: CII's 'Did you know?' heritage post drew 206 likes and 48 shares, roughly ten times its usual. SICCI dates from 1924.

delivered.title: Three people-led series, 36 posts and 27 creative concepts
points: Series: India, one member at a time; the paperwork, explained by people who do it; a hundred years, told by the families who built it
Nine SOMIN membership propositions, the three strongest in full
A 12-week calendar from 7 Sep 2026: three posts a week, 13 lead posts and a Deepavali anchor
Nine creative concepts per series, across the funnel

quote.text: Nobody enters India because of a report. They go because someone they trust already did.

outcome.title: SICCI moves 36 posts from notices to people, tracked by likes
outcome.body: Fyreflyz's youth crew shoots them at 31 Stanley Street. Success is likes per post against today's 6 for notices and 176 for people, reported every Friday.

faq.q: Which chambers was SICCI compared with?
faq.a: CII, ASME, SICC, SCCCI, SBF and SMCCI: 1,820 posts in 90 days against SICCI's 25.

faq.q: Is the heritage theme confirmed open ground?
faq.a: No. With no creator panel the read was partial, so heritage is marked possibly open, a hypothesis to test.

faq.q: How were the creative concepts scored?
faq.a: All 27 were scored for predicted clickability. None reached the 0.80 bar; the best, 35%, came from the India series. These are predictions, not results.
